purpose: Post-hoc explanatory recovery controls; not a prospective held-out confirmation or replacement decision.
width_rule: Minimum absolute Core-MAC distance to frozen LDR over uniform integer widths 3..16; tie: smaller width. No data/accuracy used.

architecture.LINEAR_CONTEXT: Change only context _Projection1D(48,24)+shuffle8 into _Projection1D(48,3)+linear interpolate6000, align_corners=False. Preserve shallow branch and local correction.
architecture.NARROW_FEATURE: Three nearest-upsample feature recovery stages T/4,T/2,T with projected encoder skips and original residual-block types; uniform width selected by Core MACs alone; no extra LDR branches.
architecture.encoder_and_context: Original component definitions and same-seed initial values; all model weights trained independently, no freezing or pretrained initialization.
architecture.historical_E4: Read-only historical comparison; different refinement/head/auxiliary design, not a direct main-path control. No new E4 seeds or INSTANCE reruns.

training.checkpoint_selection: Validation D/P/S mean F1, then P/S mean F1, S recall, lower loss, earlier epoch; exact existing lexicographic rank
training.data_order: Separate loader generators seeded with the matched training seed, as in frozen LDR runner

analysis.primary: D/P/S F1, P/S mean F1, precision, recall, FP/FN at original 0.5s tolerance
analysis.secondary: Per-model conditional MAE plus paired common-TP error distributions and success/miss composition; report all seeds and all variants
analysis.cost: Core Conv1d MACs and parameters; later same-run CPU forward timing of all three frozen seed42 models
analysis.claims: No predefined requirement that LDR wins; preserve losing or mixed outcomes.
analysis.heldout_test: Not run in this study; no automated promotion to test/INSTANCE

stop_rules: Stop on nonfinite values, source/identity mismatch, data-split mismatch, or failed execution integrity.
Do not drop a completed seed or add variants/seeds to reverse an unfavorable outcome.
No automatic restart/overwrite of an incomplete run; inspect failures first.

gpu.selection: Inspect live usage and choose one idle GPU from 0/2/3; never kill unrelated jobs.
